title: How Occoquan Humidity and I-95 Dust Load Prince William Air Ducts
headline: Woodbridge basements, Lake Ridge townhomes, and why Manassas registers go musty
description: Prince William County sits between the Occoquan and I-95. Learn why cool basement trunks sweat, how corridor dust sticks, and when to clean the ducts from Burke.

sections.heading: Prince William’s water and its highways are the same problem
paragraphs: Woodbridge, Lake Ridge, and Occoquan sit on humid air. Manassas and Gainesville sit on I-66. Dale City sits on both. A typical house has a basement air handler that stays cooler than the rest of the home. Summer air is wet. Cold metal sweats. Pollen and traffic dust stick to that film.
Townhomes along Prince William Parkway add packed dryer vents. Heat and moisture blow back into the laundry if the cap is clogged.

sections.heading: The finished basement is doing two jobs
paragraphs: It is living space. It is also the dampest room. If the ducts were never sealed well — common on 1970s–90s systems — humid air leaks in at the joints. The blower then pushes a musty smell upstairs when the AC starts after a storm.
If wiping the registers only lasts a few days, start with [air duct cleaning in Prince William County](/locations/prince-william).

sections.heading: Typical signs in Woodbridge and Manassas
listItems: Musty air from basement supplies in July and August.
Gray film on upstairs registers during pollen season.
A dryer that needs two cycles in a Lake Ridge townhome.

sections.heading: Burke dispatch — no fake Manassas shop
paragraphs: Prince William is served from our [Burke](/locations/burke) office. [Springfield](/locations/springfield) is the next Fairfax County page north.
Book on the [Prince William location page](/locations/prince-william). Add [dryer vent cleaning](/dryer-vent-cleaning) if the laundry stays hot.
listItems: Change filters when pollen is heavy.
Clean ducts every 3 to 5 years; clear dryer vents about once a year.

faq.q: Why do Woodbridge basements make ducts smell musty?
faq.a: Cool metal trunks in a humid basement sweat. Occoquan moisture and dust stick to that film. The blower pushes the odor upstairs when the system starts.
